identification: Lidded two gallon salt-glazed (cream/buff) stoneware crock with two moulded side handles and a loose-fitting lid, impressed '2 C' on the shoulder and '2' marks on the lid knob. Armitage attributes it to McHugh Brothers (Launceston, Tasmania pottery, a major Tasmanian stoneware maker). No maker stamp is visible in the photos, so attribution rests on the catalogue and form. Rim chip/rough area inside the lip, glaze wear and staining outside, lip flake on the lid.

identification: 'Cupid Awake', the 1897 sepia photographic print by M. B. (Morris Burke) Parkinson (companion to 'Cupid Asleep'), a very common Victorian/Edwardian print, here in a round turned timber frame about 14 cm diameter with glass, on a perspex stand. Print may be an original c1897-1900s or a later reproduction (cannot tell from photos). Pencil number '5463/10' on a label (seller's stock number).
marks_seen: No maker or publisher name visible on the front; pencil label '5463/10' on the frame; lot tag 117. Back not photographed so print date/publisher unverified.
